summary: An installer lock left behind by a killed install now says which lock it is and how to remove it.

replay.detail: Installer script only; no claim, replay or store change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rule change.

compatibility.detail: The installer still refuses to run while a lock directory exists; only its message changes.

manual.detail: Removing a stale lock is the same manual step the old failure implied; the message now names the directory.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; the previous installer restores its previous message.
